contents.value: Growing up as an only child, I often craved the attention of my parents and other adults in my life. Someone else who gave me attention was my nana. I loved spending time with her. When I was 9, we moved across the country and as a result our visits to my nana's house became infrequent and we grew further apart. I gained respect for her while I was away at school. She would write me letters every week and walk over to her local post office to post them. A few years ago she passed away. Yesterday, I lamented the death of my grandmother. That very day, I received a letter from her in the mail and all these memories had come flooding back to me. Oh, how I miss her.

_data.content: She had started to avoid us towards the beginning of the week .
When we had found out about her promotion, we had wanted to take her out for a celebratory dinner .
I had tried to make more of an effort to talk to her, but as time went on, she became more and more distant .
After she had received the promotion, she refused to come visit us .
From then on, it had been very clear as to what she thought of us .
